subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and ‘A = B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is N related to S if ‘N – P # S × T
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: N – P # S × T

N – P → N is the brother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6262f7cc58da8d612eab5db1990c3030e0a987cba437d0f0026a3f97b60f02b4.png] 

P # S → P is the mother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8145f5bb73242418652729445620f1bef4fd066cfef398daddefbcfbb99f6ab.png] 

S × T → S is the wife of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98bad01ada61afb08fdc1649c9cdbf59c47bec7473ead627bacbe8a3e4249af3.png] 

Thus, N is S's mother's brother or maternal uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
